result.topic_en: Latin text on the boundary values of the series from sections 48-54 at q_0 = e^{xi}, giving formula 62 for the integral of (log k - log 4 sqrt q) dq/q as a series in log 4cos^2(nx/2), and discussing convergence and closed forms when x/2π is rational.

$-4\pi i\cdot\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}\right) + \frac{4\pi i}{4}\left(\frac{2x}{2\pi}\right) - \frac{4\pi i}{9}\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}\right) + \frac{4\pi i}{16}\left(\frac{4x}{2\pi}\right)$
$= 2\sum \frac{(-1)^n \log 4\cos\frac{nx}{2}^2}{nn}$ $\left[+4\pi i \sum \frac{(-1)^n}{nn}\left(\frac{nx}{2\pi}\right)\right]$ ‡
